story-context.acceptanceCriteria: 1. Given I am using video player in EU, when my data is stored locally, then all sensitive data is encrypted before storage 2. Given I am an EU user, when I request my data, then I can access, export, and delete my data 3. Given data processing occurs, when personal data is handled, then data processing is transparent and consent-based 4. Given I visit video player, when cookies or tracking are used, then cookie consent is properly implemented 5. Given user data is stored, when retention policies are checked, then data retention policies are enforced 6. Given GDPR compliance audit is performed, when comprehensive review is conducted, then GDPR compliance audit passes

Must meet all GDPR Article 25 requirements for data protection by design
